summary: Intel Corporation filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten secondary offering of 210,526,315 common shares at $95.00 per share, raising approximately $20 billion in gross proceeds. The offering is priced at a 2.6% discount to the August 10, 2026 closing price of $97.52. Underwriters have a 30-day option for an additional 31,578,947 shares. Joint book-runners include J.P. Morgan, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and Citigroup. This is an ordinary equity capital raise, not a special-situation transaction, with proceeds intended for general corporate purposes.
